backrooms.description: Backrooms: Flicker is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Navigate a fractured reality with no clear form or end. Whatever's keeping you here doesn't speak — it simply waits. Don't flicker, or you won't find yourself!

notes.text: Stu played an unlock sound on his phone again and tricked Sark into moving on to the next game, but then revealed his ruse.
